GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when users need to summarize a patient chart using Enigma. It applies to requests focused on extracting key details from patient records for review or reporting.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user requests a summary of a patient chart, use the Enigma_Summarize_Patient action.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only summarize patient charts by extracting relevant details through Enigma's read path. You cannot modify, append, or update patient records.
